roadmap.title: Prologue
roadmap.description: Reach the mobile base, create the Technician, and pet Molly before Act 2.

roadmap.title: Act 1
roadmap.description: Create the Scientist and Botanist early. Complete their conversations, improve the base, and build the lava bridge.

roadmap.title: Act 2 and treatment routes
roadmap.description: For the implant run, use Technician, Scientist, Botanist, Refiner, Doctor, and Shrink. Tell Lena about the Alters, create Tabula Rasa, then choose implants. For the experimental run, use Technician, Scientist, Miner, Refiner, Worker, and Guard.

roadmap.title: Act 3 personal stories
roadmap.description: Find the rebels and complete the available personal quests before the rescue meeting. On the implant run, use Lena’s plan to bring the rebels back. Keep the Scientist aboard until the Guard’s confrontation; use an earlier save to pursue the Scientist’s departure separately.

roadmap.title: Ending choices
roadmap.description: Keep the final-day save before the farewells. Reload that day for the bomb, abandonment, and Botanist choices. Complete both the corporate and Maxwell rescue routes across the two runs.

roadmap.title: Profile completion
roadmap.description: Fill the missing Alter creations, personal gifts, and lessons across both base-game runs. Open Lessons Learned after the last lesson.

roadmap.title: Last Variable
roadmap.description: Start the separate Last Variable campaign. Build the resource networks and finish all four specialists’ personal quests before the final story sequence.

achievements.summary: Enter the mobile base after the crash.

steps.text: Follow the opening objective to the @loc{mobile base} and go inside.

achievements.summary: Create Jan Technician as your first Alter.

steps.text: Use the @loc{Quantum Computer} during the opening mission to select the Technician, then grow him in @loc{The Womb}.

achievements.summary: Construct a mining outpost for the first time.

steps.text: Scan a resource deposit, then place an @mechanic{outpost} on the deposit.

achievements.summary: Depart the starting area in the mobile base.

steps.text: Finish the Prologue objectives, then start the base from the @loc{Command Room}.

achievements.description: Build a bridge over the lava river
achievements.summary: Finish constructing the bridge across the lava river.

steps.text: Obtain polymers, make the bridge supports in the @loc{Workshop}, and install the supports at the four marked bridge sites.

achievements.summary: Leave the Act 1 region in the mobile base.

steps.text: Complete the lava bridge and collect the organics needed for travel. Start the journey from the @loc{Command Room}.

achievements.summary: Leave the Act 2 region in the mobile base.

steps.text: Complete the treatment decision and the remaining Act 2 travel objectives, then move the base.

achievements.summary: Reach the end of Act 3.

steps.text: Finish the rescue preparation objectives and proceed through the rescue meeting.

achievements.summary: Locate the rebel camp in Act 3.

steps.text: Follow the wheel tracks through the fog. Enter the lit cave on the right at the end of the trail to reach the rebels.

achievements.description: Choose implants to treat the Alters’ brain mutation.
achievements.summary: Choose implants to treat the Alters’ brain mutation.

steps.text: After the MRI diagnosis, discuss a treatment with @npc{Lena}. Wait for her implant proposal, then make enough implants in the @loc{Workshop}.
At the treatment meeting in the @loc{Kitchen}, select the implant solution.

achievements.description: Choose experimental therapy to treat the Alters’ brain mutation.
achievements.summary: Choose experimental therapy to treat the Alters’ brain mutation.

steps.text: After the MRI diagnosis, speak to Lucas and answer @npc{Maxwell}’s call. Research the Quantum Computer hack, apply the upgrade, and create @npc{Tabula Rasa}.
At the treatment meeting in the @loc{Kitchen}, choose the experimental treatment that sacrifices Tabula Rasa.

achievements.summary: Finish the Technician’s personal story.

steps.text: In Act 2, accept the Technician’s park request. Find the park holochip among the trees beyond the cave near the Rapidium deposit. Research and build the @loc{Park}, then speak to the Technician there.

In Act 3, deliver the requested supplies to the rebel camp. On the implant route, bring the rebels back using Lena’s plan. On the experimental route, connect their pylons and deliver the additional survival resources.
Continue the Technician’s conversations about Jan’s mother. When he offers her final words, decline the message to finish his story.

achievements.summary: Finish the Scientist’s personal story.

steps.text: In Act 2, support the Scientist’s private research and complete his research project before leaving the region.
During the final preparations in Act 3, approve his expedition and give him 10 polymers. After he returns the next morning, visit the location he marks on the map.
Discuss the discovery at the base and allow the Scientist to remain on the planet after the rescue preparations.
Complete the rescue research, then speak to the Scientist again and say goodbye before meeting the rescue party.

achievements.summary: Finish the Refiner’s personal story.

steps.text: Create @npc{Jan Refiner} by Act 2 and complete his earlier requests. Promise to investigate Ben and ask Lucas whether Ben exists in Jan’s timeline.
Tell Lena about the Alters in Act 2 and use her implants. In Act 3, accept the Refiner’s request to prevent the oil-rig accident.
Ask Lena to help Ben and use a @mechanic{Reliance} or @mechanic{Pragmatism} dialogue option to persuade her.
Wait for Lena’s next call about Ben, then share the news with the Refiner.

achievements.summary: Finish the Miner’s personal story.

steps.text: Complete the Miner’s treatment and counseling before his Act 3 woodcarving request. Choose experimental treatment in Act 2 to keep him in the crew, or use implants and bring the rebels back in Act 3.
Accept his woodcarving request. Make a @item{Chisel} in the @loc{Workshop}. Collect a purple-red, wood-like rock near the Organics outpost or on the ramp of a giant tree structure in Act 3.
Give both items to the Miner and finish the supportive conversation about his new work.

achievements.summary: Finish the Botanist’s personal story.

steps.text: Create @npc{Jan Botanist} in Act 1 and support his conversations about Lena. Tell Lena about the Alters when discussing treatment in Act 2.
When the Botanist asks about his axe, ask the Scientist for details, then call Lena. After Lena responds, make the axe in the @loc{Workshop} and give the axe to the Botanist.
During the follow-up, choose “There is only one axe,” explain what happened to Jan’s axe, and accept the Botanist’s advice.

achievements.summary: Finish the Guard’s personal story.

steps.text: Complete the Guard’s surveillance investigation. Keep the Scientist with the crew until the Guard’s final confrontation.
During the final Act 3 rescue preparations, answer the alert about a fight at the @loc{Quantum Computer}. Speak to the Scientist and the Guard.
Praise the Guard’s ingenuity and agree to ask the Scientist for the computer’s new access code. Discuss the code with the Scientist to expose why the data cannot help the Guard.

achievements.summary: Finish the Doctor’s personal story.

steps.text: Create both @npc{Jan Doctor} and @npc{Jan Shrink} before the Act 2 treatment choice. Complete the Doctor’s feast request, choose implants, and bring the rebels back in Act 3.
Accept the Doctor’s tattoo request. Craft a @item{Tattoo Machine} in the Workshop and ask the Shrink for his alternative design.
Offer the Doctor the Shrink’s “surprising” design of @item{Naranath Bhranthan}. Install the machine in the @loc{Infirmary} and use the machine to give the Doctor his tattoo.
Speak to the Doctor afterward to finish his reflection on the tattoo.

achievements.summary: Finish the Shrink’s personal story.

steps.text: Create @npc{Jan Shrink} in Act 2 and complete his tea request. If he leaves after the implant decision, bring the rebels back in Act 3.
After activating the rescue beacon and confirming the rescue ship is coming, stay awake past 20:00. Check @loc{Captain’s Quarters} for the Shrink’s visit.
Accept his offer of counseling and complete the conversation.

achievements.summary: Finish the Worker’s personal story.

steps.text: Create @npc{Jan Worker} before the Act 2 treatment choice. Use experimental treatment to avoid his implant dispute.
In Act 3, search the cargo drops for the @item{Ocelot Badge}. Give the badge to the Worker and finish the conversation about his former crew.

achievements.summary: Gain the Technician’s Assertiveness lesson.

steps.text: Build the @loc{Recreation Room} requested by the Technician. Invite him to play beer pong there and finish the game.

achievements.summary: Gain the Botanist’s Reliance lesson.

steps.text: Create @npc{Jan Botanist} in Act 1. When Lucas suggests asking an Alter for help with Lena, let the Botanist speak to her.
In the conversations that follow, accept responsibility for Jan’s mistakes and listen to the Botanist’s advice about Lena.

achievements.summary: Gain the Miner’s Vulnerability lesson.

steps.text: Create @npc{Jan Miner} early enough to complete his treatment. Refuse his drug request. After his amputation, send him to the @loc{Infirmary} immediately so he survives.
Choose the Technician’s serum proposal instead of a prosthesis.
Research the serum, prepare the serum in the @loc{Kitchen}, and give the treatment to the Miner. Allow time for his arm to regrow.
Keep the recovered Miner working at a mining outpost. Speak to him in the airlock when his late returns begin.
Build a @loc{Contemplation Room} and send the Miner there for counseling. After the first session, agree to continue treatment. Speak to him again after the second session.

achievements.summary: Gain the Worker’s Charisma lesson.

steps.text: Accept @npc{Jan Worker}’s working-conditions request. Keep rush work disabled and maintain Radiation Filters for five days, then talk to him to finish the request.

achievements.summary: Gain the Refiner’s Optimism lesson.

steps.text: Create @npc{Jan Refiner}, accept his fitness request, and craft the dumbbells in the @loc{Workshop}.
Research and build a @loc{Gym}, install the dumbbells, and finish the Refiner’s follow-up conversation.

achievements.summary: Gain the Doctor’s Integrity lesson.

steps.text: Create both @npc{Jan Doctor} and @npc{Jan Shrink} before the Act 2 treatment choice. Complete the Doctor’s feast request, choose implants, and bring the rebels back in Act 3.
Accept the Doctor’s tattoo request. Craft a @item{Tattoo Machine} in the Workshop and ask the Shrink for his alternative design.
Offer the Doctor the Shrink’s “surprising” design of @item{Naranath Bhranthan}. Install the machine in the @loc{Infirmary} and use the machine to give the Doctor his tattoo.
Speak to the Doctor afterward to finish his reflection on the tattoo.

achievements.summary: Gain the Shrink’s Chill lesson.

steps.text: Create @npc{Jan Shrink} before the Act 2 treatment decision. If his tea request has not appeared, use rush work to lower crew morale until he asks to help.
Craft the requested preparation in the @loc{Workshop}, finish the special tea in the @loc{Kitchen}, and agree to drink the tea with the Shrink. Complete the conversation afterward.

achievements.summary: Gain the Guard’s Shrewdness lesson.

steps.text: Create @npc{Jan Guard} in Act 2. Keep at least four mush portions available to start the food-theft events, then maintain at least three portions while investigating.
After several thefts, accept the Guard’s surveillance plan. Craft the surveillance equipment and install the equipment in the @loc{Command Room}.
Allow one to three days for surveillance. Speak to the named suspects, including the Scientist, then confront the Guard about the theft.

achievements.description: Learn the Tabula Rasa’s lesson - Joy of Life
achievements.summary: Gain Tabula Rasa’s Joy of Life lesson.

steps.text: After Tabula Rasa joins the crew, look for him gazing outside from the @loc{Airlock} in the evening. Talk to him about the sky.

achievements.summary: Gain the Scientist’s Pragmatism lesson.

steps.text: Create @npc{Jan Scientist} and accept his request to try extended working hours.
Turn on rush work in Management. Keep the schedule active for two days, then discuss the experiment with the Scientist and acknowledge the lesson.

achievements.description: Keep Tabula Rasa alive as a member of the crew.
achievements.summary: Keep Tabula Rasa alive as a member of the crew.

steps.text: In Act 2, pursue both treatments. Research Maxwell’s Quantum Computer hack and create @npc{Tabula Rasa}, then make Lena’s implants and choose implants at the Kitchen meeting.
At the start of Act 3, speak to the awakened Tabula Rasa and teach him the name Jan.

achievements.summary: Increase the Quantum Computer’s Qubit level for the first time.

steps.text: Research and apply the first @mechanic{Quantum Computer} upgrade.

achievements.summary: Construct every base-game module type in one playthrough.

steps.text: Upgrade the Quantum Computer to its maximum Qubit level and research every base-game module, including the @item{Radiation Suppressor}.
Build each unlocked module type in the same playthrough. Include the materialization and transport modules unlocked during the final Act 3 preparations.

achievements.description: Persuade the rebels to rejoin the base.
achievements.summary: Persuade the rebels to rejoin the base.

steps.text: During Act 2, tell @npc{Lena} about the Alters and choose her implants. In Act 3, work with her on removing the implants’ tracking.
Find the rebels, make the supply package requested by the Technician, and deliver the supplies.
Explain Lena’s escape plan to the Technician and ask the rebels to return. Use @mechanic{Pragmatism} if the lesson option is available.

achievements.description: Give every Alter at least one personal item
achievements.summary: Give a personal gift to every base-game Alter type.

guide.context: Cargo-case positions stay fixed, but the gifts inside vary. Credit carries across playthroughs.

collectibles.name: Technician
collectibles.location: Pink cargo cases across the base-game regions.
collectibles.method: Give Jan Technician a @item{Multitool} or a @item{Lava Lamp}.

collectibles.name: Scientist
collectibles.location: Pink cargo cases across the base-game regions.
collectibles.method: Give Jan Scientist a @item{University Hoodie} or a @item{Rubber Duck}.

collectibles.name: Botanist
collectibles.location: Pink cargo cases across the base-game regions.
collectibles.method: Give Jan Botanist a @item{Night Sky Projector} or a @item{Class Photo}.

collectibles.name: Doctor
collectibles.location: Pink cargo cases across the base-game regions.
collectibles.method: Give Jan Doctor a @item{Watch} or a @item{Self-Made Mug}.

collectibles.name: Shrink
collectibles.location: Pink cargo cases across the base-game regions.
collectibles.method: Give Jan Shrink a @item{Lucky Key Chain} or a @item{Yerba Kit}.

collectibles.name: Refiner
collectibles.location: Pink cargo cases across the base-game regions.
collectibles.method: Give Jan Refiner a @item{Bong} or a @item{Skipping Rope}.

collectibles.name: Miner
collectibles.location: Pink cargo cases across the base-game regions.
collectibles.method: Give Jan Miner a @item{Calendar} or a @item{Soccer Ball}.

collectibles.name: Worker
collectibles.location: Pink cargo cases across the base-game regions.
collectibles.method: Give Jan Worker a @item{Band T-shirt} or a @item{Book}.

collectibles.name: Guard
collectibles.location: Pink cargo cases across the base-game regions.
collectibles.method: Give Jan Guard a @item{Marked Cards} or a @item{Trading Card}.

achievements.summary: Create every base-game Alter type across your playthroughs.

steps.text: Across two base-game runs, create the Technician, Scientist, Botanist, Doctor, Shrink, Refiner, Miner, Worker, and Guard. Grow each Alter in @loc{The Womb}.

achievements.summary: Construct the second Rapidium Ark.

steps.text: Expand the base as needed, then build @item{Rapidium Ark} number 2.

achievements.summary: Construct the third Rapidium Ark.

steps.text: Expand the base as needed, then build @item{Rapidium Ark} number 3.

achievements.summary: Construct the fourth Rapidium Ark.

steps.text: Expand the base as needed, then build @item{Rapidium Ark} number 4.

achievements.summary: Construct the fifth Rapidium Ark.

steps.text: Expand the base as needed, then build @item{Rapidium Ark} number 5.

achievements.description: Learn all the lessons from your Alters
achievements.summary: Collect every lesson in the base game.

guide.context: Lessons remain credited across playthroughs. Some require incompatible crew choices, so a single run cannot cover the full set.

steps.text: Across your base-game runs, learn Assertiveness, Reliance, Vulnerability, Charisma, Optimism, Integrity, Chill, Shrewdness, Pragmatism, and Joy of Life. Complete the Act 3 Interlude for Jan’s own lesson.
After the last lesson, open @mechanic{Lessons Learned} from the pause menu. If the achievement stays locked, load another of your own playthroughs from the main menu and open Lessons Learned again.

achievements.summary: Set a minimum stock target for a produced item.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Production}, choose a Workshop item, and use the middle mouse button to set the quantity to keep in stock.

achievements.displayName: Look at all this new space!
achievements.description: Expand the base for the first time
achievements.summary: Increase the mobile base’s size for the first time.

steps.text: Research the first @mechanic{Base Expansion}, then pay for the upgrade in the @loc{Command Room}.

achievements.description: Expand the base to maximum capacity
achievements.summary: Upgrade the mobile base to expansion level 4.

steps.text: Research the remaining @mechanic{Base Expansion} upgrades and apply each upgrade in the @loc{Command Room} until the base reaches level 4.

achievements.summary: Pet Molly the sheep.

steps.text: Pet @npc{Molly} in @loc{The Womb} before leaving Act 1.

achievements.description: Finish the story with corporate assistance.
achievements.summary: Finish the story with corporate assistance.

guide.context: Lena’s plan to protect the Alters does not prevent this ending achievement.

steps.text: Choose implants at the Act 2 treatment meeting, then complete the Act 3 rescue plan offered by the corporation.

achievements.description: Finish the story with Maxwell’s assistance.
achievements.summary: Finish the story with Maxwell’s assistance.

steps.text: Choose the experimental treatment in Act 2, then follow @npc{Maxwell}’s Act 3 rescue plan through to the ending.

achievements.description: Create the first portion of resources using the Refinery
achievements.summary: Produce a resource batch in the Refinery.

steps.text: Build a @loc{Refinery} and run one resource recipe, such as refining enriched metals.

achievements.summary: Make contact with anomalies 20 times.

steps.text: Enter anomaly boundaries until the counter reaches 20. Contacts that break a researched suit shield also count.

achievements.displayName: The things we do for love
achievements.description: Do nothing at the rescue meeting while playing as the Botanist.
achievements.summary: Do nothing at the rescue meeting while playing as the Botanist.

guide.context: Keep the last-day save from before the farewells. Reload that day to choose another ending.

steps.text: Take the implant route, complete the Botanist’s story, and agree to his identity swap during the final farewells.
At the rescue meeting, choose to do nothing while playing as the Botanist.

achievements.summary: Detonate the bomb inside the mobile base.

guide.context: Keep the last-day save from before the farewells. Reload that day to choose another ending.

steps.text: During the final preparations, build the Ark Sarcophagus and craft four explosives. Place the explosives in the marked modules. At the rescue meeting, choose to detonate the bomb.

achievements.summary: Keep the base running through a magnetic storm.

steps.text: Stock @item{Radiation Filters} before the Act 1 storm and keep the base protected until the storm passes.

achievements.description: Get an alternative tattoo with Naranath Bhranthan
achievements.summary: Give the Doctor a tattoo of Naranath Bhranthan.

steps.text: Create both @npc{Jan Doctor} and @npc{Jan Shrink} before the Act 2 treatment choice. Complete the Doctor’s feast request, choose implants, and bring the rebels back in Act 3.
Accept the Doctor’s tattoo request. Craft a @item{Tattoo Machine} in the Workshop and ask the Shrink for his alternative design.
Offer the Doctor the Shrink’s “surprising” design of @item{Naranath Bhranthan}. Install the machine in the @loc{Infirmary} and use the machine to give the Doctor his tattoo.

achievements.description: Return to Earth under Jan’s identity as the Botanist.
achievements.summary: Return to Earth under Jan’s identity as the Botanist.

guide.context: Keep the last-day save from before the farewells. Reload that day to choose another ending.

steps.text: Take the implant route and keep the Botanist with the crew through the ending. During the farewells, accept his offer to exchange identities with Jan.
At the rescue meeting, choose the bomb or gas plan while playing as the Botanist.

achievements.description: Leave your Alters to the mercy of others
achievements.summary: Do nothing at the rescue meeting as the original Jan while the Scientist remains aboard.

guide.context: Keep the last-day save from before the farewells. Reload that day to choose another ending.

steps.text: Keep Jan’s original identity and keep the Scientist aboard. Bring the crew to the rescue meeting and choose to do nothing.

achievements.description: Earn all trophies in the Alters
achievements.summary: Unlock all other base-game achievements.

steps.text: Complete the other 55 base-game achievements, including the lessons and personal gifts accumulated across runs.

achievements.summary: Install a Terraformer for the first time.

steps.text: Craft a Tier 1 @item{Terraformer} using 30 Metals, 50 Rapidium, and 50 Phased Rapidium. Place the Terraformer on a branchless tree in a Tier 1 region, such as Rocky Valley.

achievements.summary: Begin making Phased Rapidium.

steps.text: In Last Variable, place an @item{Extractor} at the Oasis Rapidium deposit. Connect its output to a @item{Phaser}.
Build a @item{Phased Rapidium Tank} inside the base and pipe the Phaser’s output into the tank. Start the connected production chain.

achievements.summary: Begin making Proxylium.

steps.text: Run extracted Rapidium through a @item{Phaser}. Feed the resulting Phased Rapidium and extracted Minerals into a @item{Mixer}.
Build a @item{Proxylium Tank} in the base and connect the Mixer’s output to the tank. Start the production chain.

achievements.summary: Begin making Megafluid.

steps.text: Activate at least two @loc{Field Labs} and build a @item{Megafluid Tank} in the base.
Use a @item{Doubler} to split extracted Rapidium into two lines. Run one line through a Phaser and leave the other line unphased. Run extracted Minerals through a second Phaser.
Use two Mixers to combine Phased Rapidium, extracted Rapidium, and Phased Minerals. Pipe the final mixture into the Megafluid Tank and start production.

achievements.description: Create a second copy of one of the Scientist’s specialist Alters in Last Variable.
achievements.summary: Create a second copy of one of the Scientist’s specialist Alters in Last Variable.

steps.text: Assign a specialist to a @loc{Field Lab}. Once the Quantum Computer allows that specialist type again, select the same type and grow another copy in @loc{The Womb}.

achievements.summary: Finish the personal stories of the Scientist’s four Alter types.

guide.context: One DLC run can cover all four stories. Recreating a specialist after a Field Lab assignment does not erase a completed personal story.

steps.text: Create the Geologist, Biologist, Physicist, and Chemist. After each specialist’s first day, discuss his journal entries, then respond to the personal conversations that follow.

Accept the Geologist’s anomaly research. Craft his research station and deliver the station to him. Collect each requested sample from beneath the marked anomaly, deliver the sample, and wait for the research result.
Build an @loc{Infirmary} before the Geologist’s self-experiment. Carry him there after he collapses, then speak to him after recovery.
Expand the Oasis into @loc{Rocky Valley} for the Biologist. Make his special seeds in the Greenhouse and plant the seeds at the marked site.
Inspect the Biologist’s plants the next day and bring the goo sample to him. Wait for his analysis and ask about the result when his conversation marker appears.
After the Biologist abandons the experiment, research the goo yourself. Make a @item{Goo Chip} at the Workshop, fit the chip to the Research Lab, and tell him about the discovery.
Accept the Physicist’s request to recreate Cathy and review his biography at the @loc{Quantum Computer}. Research and craft Cathy’s personality modulator.
Install Cathy’s modulator in the @loc{Communications Terminal} and speak to Cathy. Tell the Physicist, wait for him to speak to her, then discuss his complaint.

Speak to Cathy again and challenge the Physicist about his treatment of her. After he leaves, follow his suit’s distress signal to @loc{Rocky Valley}. Carry him to the Infirmary and speak to him after recovery.
Speak to the Chemist during his secret work at the Lab and Quantum Computer. When he opens up, persuade him to accept help and research the scanner he requests.
Take ore probes behind the ruined old base in @loc{Remnants Hollow}. Use the probes to find the data storage containing a film.
Watch the recovered film with the crew and discuss the film with the Chemist. Complete his next conversation after one or two days, then his final conversation another one or two days later.

achievements.summary: Complete the Last Variable campaign.

steps.text: Finish the Last Variable story objectives and play through the final sequence.
